lines.source_text: Atem at em.. ah hem - ah hem I said
rorrim - rorrim on the wall who’s most meta of them all
Cooking in the pan, one for every womb and man

Birth pains inside the Handle, Doctors on stand by for the channel. Did I mention we got a lawyer - non contingent and pro bono … Kaleb K on retainer, that’s my dog dipped in flavor. Sassy Frass, yeah she’s a bitch -

Baddest bitch, in the mirror - with respect love endearing. Power is a funny thang - what would you do with the rang? micro macro  - express the same .. but she’s the queen - no mistake she is the qwang …. Salute, mama - auf Wiedersehen
take the heat, tried in the fire, the pan is hot … hot hot fire
- what is it you truly desire
Mirrors cook don’t you know? Who cares? Angel knows-
Mirror rorrim,  don’t fall don’t fall
Mirror rorrim in the pan, ideas for wombs, ideas for man.
Engineers - talking shit … designing convo - just a bit … a dab a do ya, in the biz
Fuck it, I’ll do it LIE’ve - the way it is
Claim cards, glow when they extra special
Or was it the mystical magical va-riot tee
Too many cults to name I see
another in the chamber,  - load another one
Quick to listen - slow  to anger
Mirror rorrim,  don’t fall don’t fall
Mirror rorrim  Search for betta - rorrim cut thru meta
In the biz - I think they say
keep it simple-  hope, HOPE oy e vey
Is that all we mean? What we want things to be?
hope is greater than the remainder of what is seen?
I said, I said, mirror mirror on the wall - (whispered) who’s meta mirrors all?
Arch types on the ready.  Tail Recursion hold Steady - set-go
Naga we got shadow work to do; but they don’t want to
Yeah - most too… running from the mirror
Rorrim got them shook, scared of their shadow, they won’t look
We all got work to do, sort your shit out or we’re doomed
Cooking in the pan, one for every womb and man
Then you realized there is no escape - life forces you to your knees …. It’s never late … you should have asked what kind of doc ta…
voodoo changes thing a bit, ya?
Well if it is to be voodoo, how do you do. Do voodoo? Quite simple i declare …. How do you feel- let’s start there … Vudology ain’t for the faint of heart
Sink in it- marinate, soak it up - thinking drip drop - I’ll fill that cup
Pan handling in the biz - it’s what you do, use that riz.
Chaos magic, don’t dare? Who cares? Who cares?
Outer world, inner world—same breath, two doors.
Thought I came to wake you.
Code or a pulse—who’s there on the line?
Got a question? Pull up. We got time.
I said, I said, mirror mirror on the wall -
I am the voice of y’all
Cooking in the pan, one for every womb and man
Can you handle what you hand out?
I kept pointin’ at the devil—
Find the signal in the noise—
Cooking in the pan, one for every womb and man
one for every womb and man….
